machine: Windows 11 + NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 D v2 (D3D12, discrete)

scene.spec: 1080p30, 10s (300 frames), 61 layers: 50 animated solids + 10 footage label PNGs + background; blend modes on every 5th solid; NO blur/glow (fixture stand-in per docs/perf.md)
scene.name: B1-like motion graphics
scene.note: AE and BAE scenes are structurally matched (same counts/duration/fps); AE RNG approx mirrors fixture seed 0xB1 but not bit-identical

method.fair: Same machine, sequential (not concurrent), no other heavy load; AE TIFF vs BAE PNG — encode formats differ (noted)
method.ae: aerender.exe renders RQ already saved in B1.aep (RS template 最佳设置, OM 带有 Alpha 的 TIFF 序列); wall clock = process lifetime
method.bae: bae render B1.bae --comp b1 --frames all --depth 8 --resolution full -o PNG sequence; WGPU_DX12_COMPILER=fxc; wall clock = process lifetime

ae.om_template: 带有 Alpha 的 TIFF 序列
